scenarios.title: Loading
limitations: Input 3 is a fixture mapping; verify physical wiring before production.

scenarios.title: Unloading
limitations: Input 4 is a fixture mapping; ACC alone cannot confirm unloading.

scenarios.title: Waiting
limitations: A stop in a zone is waiting evidence, not proof that cargo is being handled.

scenarios.title: Rest break
limitations: The rest duration is an accelerated sandbox threshold.

scenarios.title: Vehicle check
limitations: Checklist data is an app fixture, not a submission to the real mobile form endpoint.

scenarios.title: Refuelling
requirements: Fuel raw-value rise above noise threshold
limitations: Fuel values are raw sensor units; this does not prove litres, RPM or a calibrated fuel reading.

scenarios.title: Car wash
limitations: Media is synthetic; no camera recording or photo request is sent.

scenarios.title: Overnight parking
limitations: The shared SOS input cannot silently select or finish parking.

scenarios.title: Job complete
limitations: Running this scenario alone fails missing prerequisites; use Run all to establish them. SOS is not a completion prerequisite.

scenarios.title: SOS / Emergency
limitations: Input mapping is synthetic; this event never changes a production job mode.

scenarios.title: Snapshot button
limitations: Synthetic media proves the sandbox flow only, not physical camera capture.

limitations: All zones, wiring mappings, confirmations, checklists and media outcomes are synthetic fixtures. No Data-FM FMS or Spark geofences are used.
Virtual device time advances faster than wall time. The clock and thresholds are simulation values, not production settings.
Only telemetry and alarms traverse actual H-protocol TCP. App, geofence, media and rule events are explicitly labelled sandbox results.
ACC means ignition state. It is not PTO, loading or unloading proof.
This lab never starts, finishes or changes production jobs, and never captures real camera media.
